channel.title: StopFake
channel.description: Struggle against fake information about events in Ukraine

item.title: TU Ilmenau Students to Develop Communication Campaign Concepts for StopFake
item.dc:creator: Ольга Юркова
item.description:
StopFake has launched a collaboration with Technische Universität Ilmenau (TU Ilmenau) in Germany. During the winter semester 2026/27, international Master's students will develop communication campaign concepts aimed at strengthening StopFake's international outreach and support.

item.title: Peace on Moscow’s Terms: Disinformation Ahead of the Abu Dhabi Talks
item.dc:creator: Ольга Юркова
item.description:
On 10-11 November, Russia and Ukraine held US-mediated peace talks in Abu Dhabi. Before the meeting, the Kremlin had stated that it is genuinely ready for talks, yet its FIMI machine had been working overtime ahead of the negotiations, seeking to shape the talks before they even begun.

item.title: How Russian Propaganda Went Looking for a “Ukrainian Trail” in the Kraków Attack
item.dc:creator: Ольга Юркова
item.description:
Pro-Russian Telegram channels had no evidence linking the Kraków gunman to Ukraine. Within hours, they made that link the main lens through which they covered the tragedy.

item.title: Fake: Zelensky Is Deliberately Dragging Out Trips Abroad to Avoid Returning to Ukraine – Norwegian Outlet
item.dc:creator: hdm
item.description:
The claim is false: the president came back from his trip and worked in the capital before leaving on his next visit, which had been planned in advance.

item.title: Data Center Attacks Matter But Not in the Way We Thought
item.dc:creator: Ольга Юркова
item.description:
When Ukrainian drones struck data centers in Russia, there were hopes a potent Kremlin shadow war weapon had been blunted. The reality is more complex.

item.title: Fake: South Korea Is Cutting Military Aid to Ukraine Over a Diplomatic Row With Kyiv
item.dc:creator: hdm
item.description:
The U.S. outlet The Diplomat has retracted the article propagandists cited, admitting that its interview with the head of the South Korean defense company Newtype Industries was fabricated.

item.title: Fake: Russian Aircraft Destroyed a Drone Operators’ Base in an Underground School in Komyshuvakha
item.dc:creator: hdm
item.description:
Numerous sources confirm that the underground school was used by local institutions, served as a shelter for residents and hosted regular humanitarian aid distributions.

item.description:
Russian President Vladimir Putin declared last week that Ukrainians have no right to the occupied regions of their own country. “I think it is not their territory, but the historical territory of Russia,” he stated.
